label: Dependence shape control
paraphrase: Every well-founded graph has the existing cycle, infinite-series and source-path controls. A one-node self-loop has no injective infinite sequence, fails well-foundedness and is finitely grounded with every node intrinsic; with no intrinsic nodes its lfp is empty and gfp universal. Strict reverse Nat order is irreflexive and transitive, has a successor chain and is not well-founded. These are structural mathematical controls, with no metaphysical premise discharge.
